experiment_data.hypothesis: Granularity ablation: 对比 binary/3-class/4-class/6-class RF 性能，量化分类粒度对决策边界稀释的影响。预期 accuracy 随粒度增加单调下降，adjacent-pair AUC 在 binary 设置下最高。支持 Claim 1 (feasibility) + Claim 2 (EDD boundary dilution)。

### Dry-run 结果 (pythia_nucleus095 only)
| Setting | #Cls | Acc | 95% CI | Adjacent AUCs |
|---------|------|-----|--------|---------------|
| binary | 2 | 0.9980 | [0.9965, 0.9992] | d0v1=1.000 |
| 3class | 3 | 0.7117 | [0.6947, 0.7283] | d1v2=0.861, d2v3=0.796 |
| 4class | 4 | 0.7812 | [0.7677, 0.7935] | d0v1=0.998, d1v2=0.868, d2v3=0.804 |
| 6class | 6 | 0.6292 | [0.6175, 0.6412] | d0v1=0.997, d1v2=0.830, d2v3=0.689, d3v4=0.692, d4v5=0.691 |

决策边界稀释效应明显：accuracy 从 binary 99.8% → 4-class 78.1% → 6-class 62.9%；d2v3 AUC 从 3-class 0.796 降至 6-class 0.689。
